title: api_key URL parameter holding a placeholder, a masked display, a reference or nothing
summary: The api_key parameter with no value, an angle-bracket placeholder, an environment reference and a masked display, and a sentence that names the parameter.
rationale: An empty parameter holds nothing, an angle-bracket placeholder and an environment reference stand in for a value kept elsewhere, a masked display has no recoverable value, and a sentence that names the legacy parameter describes it. Protecting any of these would redact text a reader needs to understand how an old integration was configured.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#238, Group E). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: the texts here are an empty parameter, placeholders, references, masked text or a parameter named in prose, not credential values. That a placeholder, mask or reference is not a value is a project decision, not an Airtable statement.

sources.supports: Passing personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens via the legacy api_key URL parameter is not supported; the page names api_key as the URL parameter of the former key mechanism and does not describe the former key's format.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
